d:
Shravni mela 2026 men bihar aapka hardik svagat karta hai .
Aastha, seva aur samarpan ke is yatra men manniy mukhyamantri shri samrat chaudhri ke netritv men bihar sarkar ne kanvriyon ki surakshit, sugam aur suvidhajnak yatra sunishchit karne ke lie vyapak vyavasthaen ki hain.
Kanvriya path par chikitsa shivir, 24×7 svasthy sevaen, svachchh peyjal, vishram sthal, aadhunik tent siti, svachchh shauchalay, bhojan ki samuchit vyavastha, suraksha balon ki satat tainati, nirbadh vidyut aapurti, suchna evan sahayta kendr sahit anek suvidhaen shraddhaluon ki seva men nirantar uplabdh hain.
